K1.2 gives central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side injection cancelling exactly the intersection-one neighbours, intersection zero/two already zero, self coefficient one.

K1.3 gives central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one; neighbour definition (distinct triples, even intersection) matches paper line 696.
K1.4 states forward, inverse, forward invocations giving (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x), each restoring its own scratch wires.

K3 method says to 'tabulate the orthogonal residual of every edge' and K3.2 says every edge joins comparable labels, but the per-edge residuals and dimensions are never given (only the centre 3->4 loss P(x)F of dimension h appears), so the table itself is absent.

K3.2 says the side edge 2->5 is nested only because t_X perp t_Y, but the plan never states the residual <t_X,t_Y>^perp inside t_Y^perp or its dimension h-2, so only part of the sub-step is carried (borderline; chosen absent as the complement and dimension are missing).

K3.2 says the only decreasing edges are centre 3->4 each losing h; K3.3 gives L=Ich, telescoping at gates, sources N, sinks Wm-N and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L (the signed Wm-2N is implicit in those totals).

K3.5 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, matching the paper.

summary: P09 is a deep plan that carries the bank-exchange, label-budget totals, phase kernel, rank-deficit numerics, shear mechanics and guard-width recurrence in most detail. 21 of 26 sub-steps are present. Absent: L1 (residual table not given, only the centre loss h), L2 (side-edge nesting reason stated but not the h-2 complement), P3 (no k-column tensoring of the edge factors), M2 (no fixed odd prime avoiding denominators), S1 (nu, C0 and C1=max{20,nu+3} never defined). Borderline presents: L4 (absorption of alternating planes not spelled out), P4 (zero/full frames only implicit), M1 (elimination steps compressed to the pivot rule), S3 (final C0 d^C1 comparison missing).
